about: The reference board: the art seen with no match running (the Bevy client's ?pose mode, ci/look.mjs on SwiftShader), beside references and the operator's marks. node tools/board.mjs look shoots every view and draws the sheet; build first (cargo build --release -p server, ci/client.sh). The fx-* views are the fx stage's strips (tools/fx.sh, the fx skill): one effect over a dark and a light card, every frame of it, measured against the plate and the last run. The hd-* views are Dry Fork from four fixed eyes, shot on this box's GPU at HIGH in seconds (tools/hd.sh; the hd skill is the loop), each beside the moodboard picture it is measured against (private: ELO_REF_DIR=moodboard).
